episodes.synopsis: Narihira is quite the ladies’ man, but when the bride to be of emperor catches his eye, he begins to change. Yukihira, his oldest brother, was always the opposite when it came to love.
episodes.title: Takaiko and Narihira: The Honorable Ariwara no Narihira / Yukihira and Hiroko: The Councilor Yukihira

episodes.synopsis: Sadaakira became emperor at the age of 9 and for a time was served by Narihira, who attempted to teach him how to become a man.
episodes.title: Sadaakira and Yasuko: Emperor Yozei

episodes.synopsis: If you visit her every night for 100 nights, she will be yours to marry. But her true dream lies at the palace.
episodes.title: Munesada and Yoshiko: The Monk Henjo

episodes.synopsis: Three poets, three different styles, each express their reason and why they write poetry.
episodes.title: Yasuhide and Narihira: Funya no Yasuhide

episodes.synopsis: Yoshiko, Yasuhide, and Narihira have grown to be great friends. Yasuhide is being sent to Mikawa and Narihira is leaving too. The three friends spend an evening together gazing at the stars.
episodes.title: Eastward: Ono no Komachi

episodes.synopsis: G1 Grand Prix in the Heian Capital, Teika's Room, and Heian card battle. Prepare for an intense non-stop episode.
episodes.title: Uta Hen+

episodes.synopsis: Michitaka believes Yoshitaka relationship has gone stale and tries to help. Afterwards he needs some help with lady troubles of his own.
episodes.title: Yoshitaka and the Daughter of Minamoto no Yasumitsu: Fujiwara no Yoshitaka

episodes.synopsis: Two couples very much in love, but even time can erode at something once thought unbreakable.
episodes.title: Mount Suenomatsu: Kiyohara no Motosuke / Sanekata and Nagiko: The Honorable Fuji

episodes.synopsis: Yukinari’s father had a natural gift for poetry, a gift not passed on. Yukinari’s anti-social nature is affecting his reputation within the palace, in particular with the ladies of the court.
episodes.title: Shonagon and Yukinari: Sei Shonagon

episodes.synopsis: With the death of a prominent figure and a shakeup within the hierarchy of the palace, many things are changing and the old poets of the palace are moving on.
episodes.title: Nakoso Falls: Shonagon Kinto

episodes.synopsis: Two friends form a bond as children and promise to keep it, as adults they learn things change.
episodes.title: Kaoriko and Fujiko: Lady Murasaki

episodes.synopsis: A chance for love takes courage, not pride.
episodes.title: Michimasa and Masako: Minister of Left Kyoto Michimasa / Midnight Moon: The Former Emperor Sanjo

episodes.synopsis: A young man, not wanting to follow in his father’s footsteps, is drawn to the world of poetry by an untouchable source.
episodes.title: Teika and Noriko: Princess Shokushi Gon Chunagon Teika
